web_fixture.title: Delivery queue reference - Cobbleyard
web_fixture.snippet: The outbound queue drains in batches of 400 messages.
web_fixture.content:
# Delivery queue reference

Cobbleyard mail relay, reviewed 2026-04-21.

The relay holds accepted mail in an outbound queue and drains it in batches.
Each drain takes up to batch_messages messages, hands them to the delivery
workers and waits for the batch to settle before the next drain.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| batch_messages | 400 |
| drain_interval_s | 30 |
| retry_hours | 4 |

batch_messages belongs to the relay. Volume plans that cap the daily count set
their own figure; the table above is what a full relay ships with.

web_fixture.title: Entry plan - Cobbleyard
web_fixture.snippet: On the entry plan the outbound queue drains in batches of 50 messages.
web_fixture.content:
# Entry plan

Cobbleyard.

The entry plan caps the daily count and drains its outbound queue in batches of
50 messages, which keeps a small relay inside its daily allowance. Larger plans
take the relay default.
